title: 第四十八章 人心蛰伏第四十七章 再夺真经
content_zh:
他们在金陵住了下来。
是慕容小雪选的地方。城西一条僻静的巷子，尽头有一座小院，院子里种着一棵槐树，树荫遮了大半个院子。房子不大，但干净，有三间卧房，一间堂屋，灶房在院子东角。
房东是个寡居的老妇人，儿子在江南做生意，一年回来一两次。房子空着也是空着，听说他们是外地来的，租金给得爽快，就没有多问。
住下来的头几天，慕容小雪很忙。
她每天早出晚归，有时候连午饭都不回来吃。萧无恨不知道她在忙什么，她不说，他也不问。
但他知道，她在收拾残局。
欧阳长青死了，天幕山庄散了，飞鹰堡也倒了。四大宗主只剩上官复一个，缩在中原不动。江湖上看起来平静了，但平静底下全是暗流。
那些被欧阳长青压服的门派，现在没了约束，开始互相吞并。今天你打我，明天我打他，后天他又联合别人打你。乱成一锅粥。
还有一些人，把目光投向了萧无恨。
他们知道真经在他手上。
两本。
有人眼红，有人害怕，有人想拉拢他，有人想除掉他。
慕容小雪就是在应付这些人。
她替萧无恨挡掉了大部分的邀约和试探。今天这个门派的掌门递了拜帖，明天那个帮主的儿子送来贺礼，后天又有人想请他赴宴。她全都退了回去。
理由只有一个：萧无恨在养伤，不见客。
这个理由没有人能反驳。
谁都知道萧无恨打了一路的仗，从金陵打到飞鹰堡，中间几乎没有停过。他说他在养伤，谁还能逼他出来？
但萧无恨知道，她不是在保护他。
她是在保护那几本经书。
这些东西，放在明面上就是祸端。

蓝婷是唯一一个天天待在院子里的人。
她每天早起，打扫院子，做饭，洗衣裳。把萧无恨换下来的衣服叠得整整齐齐，放在他房门口。把慕容小雪的被子晒得蓬蓬松松，晚上收回来的时候还带着太阳的味道。
她做事很仔细，从不出错。
而且她从不多话。
萧无恨在院子里练剑的时候，她就坐在廊下，安安静静地看着。不看他的剑招，只看他的脚。他练多久，她就看多久。
萧无恨问过她一次。
“你看什么。”
蓝婷低下头，声音轻轻的。
“我看萧大哥的步法。”
她说。
“你的剑太快了，我看不清。但你的脚步很稳，每一步踩下去，地上的灰都不会扬起来。我想学。”
萧无恨没有说话。
他继续练剑。
蓝婷继续看。
她没有再问过任何问题。不问剑法，不问真经，不问他们以前的事。她像一个影子，存在，但不打扰。
这种乖巧，让萧无恨觉得很舒服。
他不喜欢被人追问。不喜欢被人盯着看。不喜欢别人用各种理由接近他，套他的话，打探他的底细。
蓝婷从来不干这些事。
她只是安静地待着，做她该做的事。
content_en:
They settled in Jinling.
It was the place chosen by Murong Xiaoxue. There is a small courtyard at the end of a secluded alley in the west of the city. There is a locust tree planted in the courtyard, and the shade of the tree covers most of the courtyard. The house is not big, but it is clean. It has three bedrooms, a main room, and the kitchen is in the east corner of the yard.
The landlord is an old widowed woman. Her son is doing business in Jiangnan and comes back once or twice a year. The house was empty. I heard that they were from out of town and the rent was readily paid, so I didn't ask any questions.
In the first few days after living here, Murong Xiaoxue was very busy.
She leaves early and comes home late every day, sometimes not even coming back for lunch. Xiao Wuhen didn't know what she was busy with. She didn't tell him, and he didn't ask.
But he knew she was picking up the pieces.
Ouyang Changqing died, Tianmu Villa fell apart, and Flying Eagle Castle fell. Of the four great sect leaders, only Shangguanfu was left, huddled in the Central Plains. The world seems to be calm, but underneath the calm there are undercurrents.
Those sects that had been subdued by Ouyang Changqing now had no restraint and began to annex each other. Today you beat me, tomorrow I beat him, and the day after tomorrow he joins others to beat you. A mess.
There were also some people who set their sights on Xiao Wuhen.
They knew that the Scripture was in his hand.
Two copies.
Some are jealous, some are afraid, some want to win over him, and some want to get rid of him.
Murong Xiaoxue was dealing with these people.
She blocked most of the invitations and temptations for Xiao Wuhen. Today the head of the sect handed over a greeting card, tomorrow the gang leader's son sent a congratulatory gift, and the day after tomorrow someone wanted to invite him to a banquet. She pulled back all.
There was only one reason: Xiao Wuhen was recuperating from his injuries and did not see any guests.
No one can refute this reason.
Everyone knew that Xiao Wuhen fought all the way from Jinling to Flying Eagle Castle, with almost no stops in between. He said he was recovering from his injuries, who could force him to come out?
But Xiao Wuhen knew that she was not protecting him.
She was protecting those scriptures.
These things are a disaster on the surface.
Lan Ting is the only one who stays in the yard every day.
She gets up early every day, cleans the yard, cooks and does laundry. He folded Xiao Wuhen's changed clothes neatly and placed them at the door of his room. Murong Xiaoxue's quilt was dried in the sun until it was fluffy and fluffy. When she took it back at night, it still smelled like the sun.
She is very careful and never makes mistakes.
And she never talks much.
When Xiao Wuhen was practicing swordplay in the yard, she sat on the porch and watched quietly. Don't look at his sword moves, just look at his feet. She watched him as long as he practiced.
Xiao Wuhen asked her once.
"What are you looking at?"
Lan Ting lowered her head and spoke softly.
"I'm watching Brother Xiao's footwork."
she said.
"Your sword is too fast, I can't see clearly. But your steps are very steady. With every step you take, the ashes on the ground will not rise. I want to learn."
Xiao Wuhen said nothing.
He continued practicing his sword.
Lan Ting continued to watch.
She asked no more questions. Don't ask about swordsmanship, don't ask about the scriptures, don't ask about their past affairs. She is like a shadow, present but not disturbing.
This kind of obedience made Xiao Wuhen feel very comfortable.
He doesn't like to be questioned. Don't like to be stared at. He doesn't like others using various reasons to approach him, trick him, and find out his details.
Lan Ting never does these things.
She just stayed quiet and did what she had to do.
